title: Insurance Claim Services Final Mold Supplement: Labor by Growth Location
content:
Q. How is labor claimed in an Insurance Claim Services final mold supplement, by growth location?

A. The labor is taken as follows: for growth in an attic or crawlspace, which no occupant uses, the labor billed with its after-hours part at the business-hours rate whatever the property, the after-hours premium being the customer's own choice there; for growth in the HVAC system, the labor billed with its after-hours part as billed whatever the property, because the system serving the building can be shut down for cleaning only outside its working hours. For growth in a living area or basement, the technician and supervisor labor billed, its after-hours part taken at the business-hours rate on a single-family house or condominium unit and as billed on a multifamily unit or commercial property.

Q. What is "the after-hours part at the business-hours rate"?

A. The technician and supervisor labor billed in the after-hours window divided by the tier's after-hours labor multiplier, which is 1.5 on every Mold Remediation tier; the business-hours labor stands as billed.

| Growth location | Labor claimed |
|---|---|
| attic or crawlspace | technician and supervisor labor billed, the after-hours part divided by the multiplier, on any property |
| HVAC system | technician and supervisor labor as billed, after-hours part included, on any property |
| living area or basement | after-hours part at the business-hours rate on a single-family house or condominium unit; as billed on a multifamily unit or commercial property |

*Hypothetical:* labor billed 1620.00, of which 540.00 after hours. Crawlspace growth on a commercial property: 1080.00 plus 360.00, or 1440.00. HVAC growth on a single-family house: 1620.00. Basement growth on a condominium unit: 1440.00; on a commercial property: 1620.00.
